controls.title: Continuous Risk Management System
controls.requirement: Establish, implement, document and maintain a continuous risk management system throughout the entire AI lifecycle.

controls.title: Data Governance & Bias Mitigation
controls.requirement: Training, validation, and testing data sets shall be subject to appropriate data governance and management practices.

controls.title: Technical Documentation & Architecture
controls.requirement: Draw up and keep up-to-date comprehensive technical documentation demonstrating compliance.

controls.title: Automatic Event Logging & Traceability
controls.requirement: High-risk AI systems shall technically allow for the automatic recording of events ('logs') over lifetime.

controls.title: Transparency & Provision of Information
controls.requirement: High-risk AI systems shall be designed to be sufficiently transparent for deployers to interpret outputs.

controls.title: Human Oversight & Intervention (Human-in-the-Loop)
controls.requirement: Enable natural persons to oversee systems, prevent automation bias, and execute an override/stop.

controls.title: Accuracy, Robustness & Cybersecurity
controls.requirement: Resilience against errors, faults, inconsistencies, data poisoning, and adversarial tampering.

controls.title: Fundamental Rights Impact Assessment (FRIA)
controls.requirement: Perform assessment of the impact on fundamental rights before putting a high-risk AI system into service.

controls.title: Legal & Regulatory Environmental Mapping
controls.requirement: Legal and regulatory requirements involving AI are understood, managed, and integrated into workflows.

controls.title: Context & Deployment Scope Definition
controls.requirement: Intended purpose, deployment context, and business value propositions are explicitly mapped.

controls.title: Quantitative Risk Metrics & Scoring
controls.requirement: Approaches and metrics for measurement of AI risks are identified, tested, and tracked over time.

controls.title: Risk Treatment & Pre-Engineered Mitigation
controls.requirement: Risks are prioritized and acted upon based on planned risk treatments (avoid, transfer, mitigate, accept).

controls.title: Data Protection by Design & Default
controls.requirement: Appropriate technical and organizational measures implemented to integrate safeguards into processing.

controls.title: AI Management System (AIMS) Accountability
controls.requirement: Leadership commitment, internal audits, and continuous risk monitoring mechanisms.
